ov: Four species of medium-sized wild cat, the Canada, Eurasian and Iberian lynx and the bobcat, with black ear tufts, a short tail and big padded paws for walking on snow.

why.dg: It doesn't usually attack people unless it is injured, trapped or ill.

rg: Europe, Asia and North America; the Iberian lynx only on the Iberian Peninsula.
fx: The name comes from a Greek root meaning light, after the glow of its reflective eyes.
